answer: The gale holds work receipts rather than names, so the vertex of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. What survives to the cipher is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work.
